QuestInfo.name: The Last Knight Training
QuestInfo.0: Begin your last knight training before you become a #p1102000# Knight.
QuestInfo.1: This time, #p1102000# has asked you to hunt the strongest of the Mimis in Ereve, the #r#o100124##ks.
QuestInfo.2: You have come back after hunting the #o100124#s. #p1102000# suggested you report to #p1101002#, as you've completed your training.

0.0: Now, shall we begin your third as well as your last training to become a knight? This time, you'll be hunting #r#o100124##ks which are also known as the most challenging Mimis in Ereve. What do you think? Do you think you can do it?

yes.0: Alright then. Report back to me after you hunt #r5#k #o100124#s in #b#m130010200##k. #o100124#s may be stronger than other Mimis, but with your prowess, this won't be too big a challenge.

no.0: Don't be scared. Give it a shot! You're a knight, you know. Muster your courage and come talk to me again.

1.0: You're back safe after hunting the #o100124#s. Impressive! You are now ready to advance from Noblesse and become a Knight-in-Training.

yes.0: So this ends your training as a Noblesse. Go on ahead. #b#p1101002##k is waiting for you. You will have officially become a Knight-in-Training the next time I see you.

mob.0: Have you not been able to defeat #b5 #o100124#s#k yet? If you don't see any #o0100124#s in #m130010200#, I suggest you try #m130010210#. You will find #o0100124#s swarming in that area.
